messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: service=embed-sim version=2.4.0 -> target 15% (regions: ap-south=6%, eu-west=5%, us-east=4%). change-window=2024-11-08T02:00Z. notify if any anomalies. :rocket:
anna: watching embedding success rates and client error queue. opening dashboard.
raj: ap-south embed error rate jumped from 0.1% -> 3.8% in last 3m. many 400s with 'vector_dim_mismatch' on client side. sample error: `HTTP 400 {"error":"vector_dim_mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024"}`
mei: that screams config drift — did the model variant change default embedding_dim? release diff showed model config bump to 1536. but older clients still expect 1024.
ops-oncall: recommend PAUSE rollout and regional pin for ap-south to previous version 2.3.9 until we confirm compatibility matrix.
deploy-bot: rollout status: 15% deployed. To pause run: `/deploy pause --id=rollout-1765443210`
ops-oncall: executing pause now.
ops-oncall: `/deploy pause --id=rollout-1765443210` -> accepted. initiating route override for ap-south.
deploy-bot: route override: ap-south pinned to version=2.3.9 (6% traffic). health checks returning 200.
anna: confirming client error queue: post-pin 400s dropped to 0.2% within 90s, backlog processing resumed.
raj: adding reproducible curl that failed: `curl -X POST https://api.ap-south.redwood/infer -d '{"input":"hello"}' -H 'X-Embed-Dim:1024'` -> 400. will attach request/response to GH issue.
mei: short-term mitigation idea: negotiate a graceful fallback on server to downsample 1536->1024 when header indicates older client, log once per minute. safer to patch later than break clients.
ops-oncall: agree but avoid silent data loss. prefer pin + client update notification. ops will coordinate with release-eng on customer comms.
release-eng: drafting release note: "v2.4.0 embed dimension changed to 1536; staged rollout paused after ap-south client compatibility issues; ap-south pinned to v2.3.9. Follow-up: compatibility shim or coordinated client rollout."
anna: plan for next steps: 1) hotfix? add runtime compatibility shim and tests, 2) or bump clients via SDK + coordinated release. propose hotfix v2.4.1 limited canary in ap-south after shim.
raj: will spike shim prototype and run in staging. aim to have candidate in ~3 hours.
ops-oncall: once candidate ready, request a 1% ap-south canary and 30m monitoring window before expanding.
release-eng: tagging customers on apac SDKs to expect brief maintenance window.
deploy-bot: rollout paused by ops-oncall. current global deployed fraction: 9% (ap-south pinned to 2.3.9).
mei: thanks team. good catch. documenting follow-ups in GH issue and will add regression to preflight checks for embed_dim vs client SDK versions.
